name.zh: OpenRouter 免费模型

summary.zh: 通过统一 API 使用免费模型，适合小规模测试与体验。
summary.en: Use free models through one unified API. Suited to small tests and trials.

benefit.zh: 选择带 :free 标识的模型，模型调用价格为零。
benefit.en: Models marked :free cost nothing per call.

eligibility.zh: 需要 OpenRouter 账号与 API Key；支持范围以平台和模型条款为准。
eligibility.en: Requires an OpenRouter account and API key. Coverage follows the platform and model terms.

zh: 免费变体有调用频率与每日请求限制，失败请求也可能计入。
不是所有零价格模型都适用同一规则；部分其他零价格模型仍要求账户有余额。
切换到付费模型会产生费用，使用前核对模型标识。
en: Free variants have rate limits and daily request caps; failed requests may also count.
Not every zero-price model follows the same rules; some still require a positive account balance.
Switching to a paid model incurs charges. Check the model ID before use.

cost.zh: 免费变体无需购买额度；提高限额的付费充值不属于本条免费权益。
cost.en: Free variants need no purchased credits. Paid top-ups that raise limits are not part of this perk.

deadline.zh: 免费模型清单与限额可能调整；未发现统一领取截止日期。
deadline.en: The free model list and limits may change. No common end date found.

zh: 打开官方免费模型集合，选择带 :free 标识的模型。
注册或登录账号，创建 API Key。
按对应模型文档配置调用，先做少量测试并检查用量。
en: Open the official free models collection and pick a model marked :free.
Sign up or log in, then create an API key.
Configure calls per the model docs. Start with a few test requests and check usage.

verification.zh: 已查阅官方说明，未进行领取或调用实测。
verification.en: Official documentation reviewed. Not tested by making calls.

keywords.zh: 人工智能 大模型 API token 编程 免费模型
keywords.en: artificial intelligence LLM API token programming free models

name.zh: Cloudflare Pages

summary.zh: 托管静态网站，适合个人主页、作品集与文档站。
summary.en: Static site hosting for personal pages, portfolios and documentation.

benefit.zh: Free 方案提供静态站点部署；官方文档列明每月 500 次构建。
benefit.en: The Free plan includes static site deployment. Official docs list 500 builds per month.

eligibility.zh: 需要 Cloudflare 账号与网站文件；可按平台流程连接代码仓库或上传站点。
eligibility.en: Requires a Cloudflare account and your site files. Connect a repository or upload directly.

zh: 免费方案有构建、文件数量与单文件体积限制。
Pages Functions 请求计入 Workers 配额，动态功能需另查计费。
自购域名及其他付费服务的费用不包含在静态托管内。
en: The Free plan limits builds, file count and individual file size.
Pages Functions requests count toward the Workers quota. Check pricing for dynamic features.
Purchased domains and other paid services are not included in static hosting.

cost.zh: 本条指免费方案内的静态托管；升级和附加服务按其各自条款计费。
cost.en: Covers static hosting on the Free plan only. Upgrades and add-ons are billed under their own terms.

deadline.zh: 持续提供的套餐；限制与价格以后续官方条款为准。
deadline.en: Ongoing plan. Limits and pricing follow current official terms.

zh: 打开 Pages 官方文档，检查 Free 方案限制。
登录 Cloudflare，按文档创建 Pages 项目并提交静态文件。
检查部署结果与用量，再按需要配置域名。
en: Open the Pages docs and check the Free plan limits.
Log in to Cloudflare, create a Pages project and upload your static files.
Check the deployment and usage, then set up a domain if needed.

sourceLabel.zh: 官方 Free 方案限制

verification.zh: 已查阅官方说明，未进行账号开通或部署实测。
verification.en: Official documentation reviewed. Sign-up and deployment not tested.

name.zh: GIMP

summary.zh: 跨平台图像编辑工具，用于修图、合成与平面设计。
summary.en: Cross-platform image editor for retouching, compositing and graphic design.

benefit.zh: 核心图像编辑软件免费开放，可按许可使用与修改。
benefit.en: The editor is free to use and modify under its open source license.

eligibility.zh: 使用受支持的 Windows、macOS 或 GNU/Linux 系统。

zh: 下载前核对当前版本的操作系统要求。
第三方插件、教程与服务可能采用独立收费或许可。

Third-party plugins, tutorials and services may have their own prices or licenses.

deadline.zh: 无统一活动截止日期，按开源许可使用。
deadline.en: No end date. Use under the open source license.

zh: 进入 GIMP 官方网站，打开 Download。
选择适合操作系统的版本并安装。
参考官方教程开始编辑，按需检查插件许可。
en: Go to the GIMP website and open Download.
Pick the build for your operating system and install it.
Start with the official tutorials. Check plugin licenses as needed.

Professional support, enterprise services and third-party builds may cost extra.

cost.zh: 官方套件免费；专业服务不包含在内。
cost.en: The official suite is free. Professional services are not included.

deadline.zh: 无统一活动截止日期，按开源许可使用。
deadline.en: No end date. Use under the open source license.

zh: 打开官网并选择 Download。
核对系统要求后下载对应安装包。
用副本打开已有文档，确认排版与功能符合需要。

Open a copy of an existing document to confirm layout and features meet your needs.

verification.zh: 已查阅官方说明，未进行安装及兼容性实测。

summary.zh: 为网页、演示文稿和设计项目挑选开放许可字体。
summary.en: Openly licensed fonts for websites, slides and design projects.

benefit.zh: 字体以开源许可提供，可用于个人与商业项目。
benefit.en: Fonts are released under open source licenses and can be used in personal and commercial projects.

Keep the license file after downloading, and confirm the weights and character coverage you need.

cost.zh: 所收录字体免费；不包含其他第三方字体服务。
cost.en: Listed fonts are free. Other third-party font services are not included.

deadline.zh: 无统一活动截止日期，按各字体许可使用。
deadline.en: No end date. Use under each font's license.

zh: 打开字体库，按语言与风格筛选。
检查选中字体的许可、字重及字符覆盖。
下载字体或按官方说明接入网页。
en: Open the library and filter by language and style.
Check the license, weights and character coverage of the font you picked.
Download it, or add it to a web page following the official guide.

verification.zh: 已查阅官方说明，未逐项审核所有字体许可。
verification.en: Official documentation reviewed. Individual font licenses not checked one by one.

summary.en: Photos for personal and commercial work.

benefit.zh: Unsplash 许可覆盖的免费图片可下载并用于商业或非商业用途。
benefit.en: Free images under the Unsplash License can be downloaded and used commercially or non-commercially.

eligibility.zh: 确认图片适用 Unsplash 免费许可；Unsplash+ 使用另外的许可。

人物、商标等其他权利仍需结合具体使用场景核对。

Do not compile images to replicate a similar or competing service.
Check other rights, such as people and trademarks, for your specific use.

cost.zh: 本条仅指免费许可图片，不包含 Unsplash+ 付费内容。
cost.en: Covers free-license images only, not paid Unsplash+ content.

deadline.zh: 无统一活动截止日期，使用以适用许可为准。
deadline.en: No end date. Use under the applicable license.

zh: 在官网搜索图片，确认不是付费内容。
阅读图片适用许可及具体使用限制。
下载图片，保存来源链接和许可记录。
en: Search on the site and confirm the image is not paid content.
Read the applicable license and any usage limits.
Download the image and keep the source link and license record.

verification.zh: 已查阅官方许可，未核验每张图片的其他权利。

benefit.zh: 免费访问公开的课程大纲、讲义、作业以及部分视频资料。

再使用课程内容需遵守页面许可并注明来源。
en: No MIT credit or certificates.
Not every course has full video.
Reuse of course material must follow the page license and credit the source.

deadline.zh: 没有统一的开课、结课或报名截止时间。

zh: 进入 OCW，搜索学科或课程名称。
检查课程大纲、前置要求和可用材料。
直接浏览或下载资料，按自己的进度学习。

Check the syllabus, prerequisites and available material.
Browse or download the material and study at your own pace.

benefit.zh: 官方页面集中展示免费游戏，并定期提供赠送活动。
benefit.en: The official page lists free games and runs regular giveaways.

eligibility.zh: 需符合 Epic 账号、年龄、地区和具体游戏要求。
eligibility.en: Must meet Epic account, age, region and per-game requirements.

zh: 每款限免游戏有自己的领取窗口，本条不承诺某款游戏当前仍可领取。
免费游玩、限时赠送和试玩版含义不同，领取前查看商品说明。
游戏内购及付费附加内容不属于免费权益。
en: Each giveaway has its own claim window. This entry does not guarantee any game is still claimable.
Free-to-play, limited-time giveaways and demos are different. Read the product page before claiming.

cost.en: Only items the page clearly marks as free. In-game purchases and other paid items cost extra.

deadline.zh: 动态活动入口；具体截止时间以当期商品页为准。

benefit.zh: 每位用户、每个账户限领一次 250 美元沙箱算力额度，按秒计费，先扣这笔额度。

eligibility.zh: 须在 2026 年 9 月 22 日至 2027 年 1 月 31 日期间新注册 Docker Agentic Platform。

en: A valid credit card is required at signup; the card is charged only for usage beyond the credit.
The credit covers sandbox compute only (from start to stop, including setup, idle time and retries), not model APIs or agent subscriptions.
Credits are non-transferable, have no cash value, and expire six months after you claim them. Unused credit is forfeited and you are not charged for it.

cost.zh: 额度本身免费，但注册须绑卡；超出额度的用量按官方价目扣款。
cost.en: The credit itself is free, but a card is required at signup. Usage beyond the credit is billed at the official rates.

deadline.zh: 须在 2027 年 1 月 31 日 23:59 PT 前注册领取；额度自领取起 6 个月有效。

在沙箱中使用算力，并在领取后 6 个月内用完额度。
en: Open Docker's official sandbox offer page.
Sign up for Docker Agentic Platform during the offer and add a card as the page requires.
Use the credit on sandbox compute and finish it within six months of claiming.

zh: 免费额度仅在华北 2（北京）地域发放和使用。
同一实名主体不能重复领取。
额度用完后默认转为按量付费；可在控制台开启「免费额度用完即停」。
官网文档未写「活动至 11 月 30 日」之类的截止日期。
en: The free quota is issued and used only in the China North 2 (Beijing) region.
The same real-name entity cannot claim it again.

The official docs do not state a campaign end date such as November 30.

cost.zh: 新人额度免费；未开启用完即停时，超额将按量计费。
cost.en: The new-user quota is free. If you do not enable stop-at-quota, usage beyond it is billed as you go.

deadline.zh: 未写活动截止日期；各模型额度自生效日起通常 90 天有效。
deadline.en: No campaign end date is stated. Each model's quota is typically valid for 90 days from when it takes effect.

zh: 用已实名的阿里云账号打开百炼控制台，系统会自动开通服务。
在「免费额度」页面查看各模型余量与过期时间。
如需避免超额扣费，开启「免费额度用完即停」。
en: Open the Model Studio console with a real-name Alibaba Cloud account; the service is enabled automatically.
Check each model's remaining quota and expiry on the Free quota page.
Turn on “stop when the free quota runs out” if you want to avoid paid overage.

summary.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude for Open Source 计划，审核通过的开源维护者和贡献者可免费获得 6 个月 Claude Ultra。
summary.en: Anthropic's Claude for Open Source program gives approved open-source maintainers and contributors 6 months of Claude Ultra for free.

benefit.zh: 审核通过后免费获得 6 个月 Claude Ultra 订阅。
benefit.en: Approved applicants get a complimentary 6-month Claude Ultra subscription.

eligibility.zh: 年满 18 岁、居住在 Claude 支持地区的自然人；GitHub 账号满 2 年；近 90 天有公开开源贡献；参与 OSI 许可项目；并满足维护者门槛之一（如依赖仓库 500 个以上、月下载量 20 万以上、近 12 个月向他人仓库合并 100 个 PR、仓库近 12 个月有 20 位以上外部贡献者、仓库 OpenSSF 关键性评分 0.4 以上等），或说明项目对生态的重要性。
eligibility.en: Applicants must be natural persons aged 18+ living where Claude is offered, with a GitHub account at least 2 years old, public open-source activity in the last 90 days and a project under an OSI-approved license, plus one maintainer threshold (e.g. 500+ dependent repos, 200,000+ monthly downloads, 100+ merged PRs to others' repos in 12 months, 20+ external contributors in 12 months, or an OpenSSF criticality score of 0.4+), or an explanation of the project's ecosystem impact.

zh: 达标不保证通过，由 Anthropic 逐个审核；只在通过时邮件通知。
条款写明名额上限 1 万人（可上调），Anthropic 可在名额用完或申请期结束时停止受理。
通过后须在收到兑换链接后 90 天内激活，否则作废；6 个月从激活日起算。
免费的只是 Ultra 基础订阅费；超出套餐的用量（overage）仍按 Anthropic 标准价另行计费。
已有付费订阅的，计费在这 6 个月内暂停，结束后按原套餐恢复扣费（除非提前取消）；其余回到免费档。免费订阅不会自动续期。
接受后即同意 Anthropic 公开把你列为计划受助者（可引用姓名、GitHub 用户名和项目）；订阅仅限本人使用，不可转让。
en: Meeting a threshold does not guarantee approval; Anthropic reviews each application and only emails approved applicants.
The terms cap the program at 10,000 recipients (which may be raised); applications stop when the cap is reached or the application period closes.
Approved applicants must activate within 90 days of receiving the link or it is forfeited; the 6 months start from activation.
Only the base Ultra subscription fee is waived; usage beyond the plan (overage) is still billed at Anthropic's standard rates.

An existing paid plan is paused during the 6 months and resumes at your prior plan afterwards unless you cancel first; otherwise the account returns to the free plan. The free subscription does not renew automatically.
By accepting you agree that Anthropic may publicly name you as a recipient (name, GitHub username and project); the subscription is personal and non-transferable.

deadline.zh: 未写截止日期，申请开放至名额用完或官方关闭。
deadline.en: No end date; applications stay open until the cap is reached or Anthropic closes them.

等待审核；通过后按邮件中的链接激活 Ultra。
en: Open the Claude for Open Source page and read the terms.

eligibility.zh: 微信小程序开发者，个人开发者也可参加；每个小程序账号只能参加一次。
eligibility.en: WeChat mini program developers, including individuals; each mini program account can join once.

zh: 额度按小程序发放：报名的小程序得一份资源包，不是全平台共享的总池。
Token 只能从小程序基础库、由小程序调用的云函数或云托管、云开发控制台使用；网页、脚本或第三方系统直接调用不抵扣。
报名后不能切换腾讯云账号或云开发环境；触发微信风控的资源包会提前到期。
生图额度用完后不能用套餐抵扣；代金券 6 个月有效，只能用于云开发。

en: The pack is granted per enrolled mini program, not drawn from a shared platform-wide pool.

Tokens only apply to calls from the mini program base library, cloud functions or Cloud Run invoked by the mini program, and the CloudBase console; direct calls from web pages, scripts or third-party systems are not covered.
After enrolling you cannot switch Tencent Cloud accounts or CloudBase environments; packs that trip WeChat's risk controls expire early.
Image credits cannot be topped up from the CloudBase plan once used up; the voucher lasts 6 months and only applies to CloudBase.

deadline.zh: 二期活动期为 2026 年 7 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日；资源包自申请成功起 6 个月有效。

Check the quota under AI Model Usage in the CloudBase console and call the models from your mini program as the guide describes.

Pick MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B or MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B in the model list and call the Chat Completions API with an image or video.

summary.en: Tabstack, Mozilla's web extraction and research API, includes 10,000 free credits in every new account with no card; it stops when they run out and never bills.

benefit.zh: 10,000 额度可用于全部接口：按官方价目约合 1,000 次 Markdown 提取，或 40 次 Fast Research，或二者混用（Extract JSON 50、Generate 和 Automate 各 100、Research Balanced 350）。
benefit.en: The 10,000 credits work on every endpoint: at published costs that is about 1,000 Markdown extractions, or 40 Fast Research runs, or a mix (Extract JSON 50, Generate and Automate 100 each, Research Balanced 350).

eligibility.zh: Tabstack 新注册账号。
eligibility.en: New Tabstack accounts.

zh: 官方写的是「每个新账号含 10,000 免费额度」，没有每月重置的说法，按一次性额度理解；官方没写有效期。
试用账号（Trial）不产生超额费用：额度用完请求即停，永远不扣费。
要继续用得升级到 Starter（10 美元/月）等付费档，不在本条内。
官方没写试用账号的每分钟请求上限；各付费档为 15、25、100 次/分钟。
en: The official wording is that every new account includes 10,000 free credits; there is no monthly reset, so treat it as a one-time allowance. No expiry is stated.
Trial accounts have no overages: requests stop when the credits run out and it never bills.
Continuing needs a paid plan such as Starter ($10/month), which is not part of this entry.
The Trial rate limit is not stated; the paid plans allow 15, 25 and 100 requests per minute.

deadline.zh: 官方未写截止日期。
deadline.en: No end date given.

在控制台确认 10,000 额度，创建 API Key。
按接口调用，控制台会显示每次调用的额度消耗和余额。
en: Open the Tabstack pricing page and click Start free to create an account.
Check the 10,000 credits in the console and create an API key.
Call the endpoints; the console shows each call's credit cost and your balance.

summary.en: fal accounts created within the last 7 days can make Seedance 2.5 videos free on the web: 2 on sign-in with no card, and 3 more after adding a payment method to verify, 5 in total.

benefit.zh: 登录即得 2 段免费视频，不用绑卡；注册 7 天内添加支付方式验证账号，再得 3 段，共 5 段。每段 10 秒、480p，支持文生视频、图生视频和参考生视频（最多 5 张参考图）。

eligibility.zh: 注册不超过 7 天的 fal 账号；官方写明免费视频按人计算，整个活动期间不补发。

zh: 只在 fal 网页端有效：Seedance 2.5 playground、fal sandbox 和 fal Agent；工作流和 API 照常计费。
多出的 3 段需要添加支付方式验证；官方没写验证时是否预授权或扣款。fal 是预付费充值制（官方计费文档），不买额度就不会扣款，但这一步请自行留意。
老账号（注册超过 7 天）领不了。
免费视频用完或活动结束后，按视频 Token 计费（每千 Token 约 0.0214 美元）。
en: Free only on fal web: the Seedance 2.5 playground, the fal sandbox and fal Agent; workflows and the API are billed as usual.

The extra 3 videos require adding a payment method to verify; fal does not say whether verification places a hold or charge. fal uses prepaid credits (per its billing docs), so nothing is charged unless you buy credits, but check this step yourself.
Accounts older than 7 days cannot claim it.
After the free videos, or once the offer ends, generations are billed per video token (about $0.0214 per 1,000 tokens).

cost.zh: 2 段免费、不用绑卡；添加支付方式后共 5 段免费。之后按量计费。
cost.en: 2 videos free with no card; 5 free after adding a payment method. Pay-as-you-go afterwards.

deadline.zh: 官方标「限时」，没写截止日期；每个账号须在注册 7 天内使用。

zh: 如果你还没有 fal 账号，现在注册一个（只有注册 7 天内的账号才有免费视频）。
打开 fal.ai/seedance-2.5，在网页 playground 里用提示词生成，登录后即有 2 段免费。
想要另外 3 段，在注册 7 天内于账单页添加支付方式完成验证。
en: If you do not have a fal account yet, create one now (only accounts under 7 days old get the free videos).
Open fal.ai/seedance-2.5 and generate in the web playground; 2 free videos are available once signed in.
For the other 3, add a payment method on the billing page within 7 days of sign-up to verify.

name.en: Pinecone Starter: free plan with doubled embedding tokens through December

summary.zh: Pinecone 向量数据库的 Starter 免费档，2026 年 11 月 4 日至 12 月 31 日每个内置嵌入模型每月送 1,000 万 Token（平时 500 万）。

benefit.zh: Starter 免费：2 GB 存储、每月 200 万写入单元和 100 万读取单元，最多 5 个索引；内置嵌入每个模型每月 1,000 万 Token（活动期），另含每月 500 次重排请求。
benefit.en: Free Starter: 2 GB storage, 2M write units and 1M read units a month and up to 5 indexes; integrated embedding gives 10M tokens per model per month during the promo, plus 500 rerank requests a month.

eligibility.zh: Pinecone 注册用户的 Starter 组织；Builder（每月 20 美元）不在本条内。
eligibility.en: Starter organizations of registered Pinecone users; the $20/month Builder plan is not covered.

zh: 翻倍只到 2026 年 12 月 31 日，2027 年 1 月 1 日起恢复每模型每月 500 万 Token；Starter 免费档本身继续免费。

用量到月度上限后会被拦截（返回 429），不会自动扣费，要继续得升级。
官方没写注册是否要绑卡。

Starter is limited to AWS us-east-1, 1 project and up to 2 users; gemini-embedding-2 is not available on Starter.

Pinecone does not say whether sign-up requires a card.

deadline.zh: 嵌入额度翻倍到 2026 年 12 月 31 日；Starter 档不设截止日期。
deadline.en: The embedding boost runs through December 31, 2026; the Starter plan has no end date.

创建索引并选内置嵌入模型（如 llama-text-embed-v2）。
用 API 写入文本并查询，用量可在控制台查看。

Create an index with an integrated embedding model such as llama-text-embed-v2.
Upsert text and query through the API; usage is visible in the console.

name.en: Kimi for Science: up to $20,000 in Kimi API credits for researchers

summary.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi 的科研支持计划首期开放申请，自然科学、工程及相关交叉领域的研究者和团队可申请，入选者获 Kimi API 额度和技术支持。
summary.en: Kimi's research support program is open for its first cohort. Researchers and teams in the natural sciences, engineering and related fields can apply; selected applicants get Kimi API credits and technical support.

benefit.zh: 入选者获最高 20,000 美元的 Kimi API 额度（约 70 亿 Token），具体金额按研究需求和评审结果定；另有 Kimi 团队的技术支持、新模型抢先体验和研究社区资源。
benefit.en: Selected applicants receive up to $20,000 in Kimi API credits (about 7B tokens), with the exact amount set by research needs and review. They also get technical support from the Kimi team, early access to new models and research community resources.

eligibility.zh: 自然科学、工程及相关交叉领域的研究者和研究团队；无论是改进现有工作流还是探索新方法都可申请。需说明研究背景、在做的任务、数据来源和现有流程，以及打算怎么用 Kimi、怎么评估结果。
eligibility.en: Researchers and research teams in the natural sciences, engineering and related interdisciplinary fields, whether improving an existing workflow or exploring a new method. You describe your research background, task, data sources and current workflow, plus how you will use Kimi and evaluate the results.

zh: 需申请、评审入选才有：提交申请不等于获得额度，最高 20,000 美元也不保证拿满，金额由评审决定。
额度只用于模型调用，不是现金资助。
首期 12 月 8 日前申请；官方没写时区，本条按北京时间 12 月 8 日结束处理，建议提前提交。官方称后续还会开新一期。
可多次提交，只评审最后一次；评审结果发到申请表填写的邮箱，入选和支持细节以最终评审为准。
官方页面没写额度有效期、使用限制、是否限地区或机构，这些条款无从核实。
en: Apply and be selected: submitting an application does not grant credits, and the $20,000 maximum is not guaranteed; the review sets the amount.
Credits are for model usage, not cash funding.
Applications for the first cohort close on December 8. The page gives no time zone, so this entry ends on December 8 Beijing time; submit early. Kimi says more cohorts will open later.
You may submit more than once and only the latest submission is reviewed. The result is emailed to the address in your application, and selection and support details follow the final review.
The official page does not state a credit validity period, usage limits, or any region or institution restriction, so those terms cannot be confirmed.

deadline.zh: 首期 12 月 8 日前申请（官方未写时区，按北京时间处理）。
deadline.en: First cohort: apply by December 8 (no time zone given; treated as Beijing time).

zh: 打开 Kimi for Science 官方页面，阅读申请说明。
点「Apply now」，在页内表单填写研究背景、任务、数据来源和现有流程，以及使用 Kimi 的方式和评估方法；预估 Token 用量和项目里程碑可选填。
12 月 8 日前提交，等待邮件通知评审结果。

Click “Apply now” and fill in the on-page form with your research background, task, data sources, current workflow, how you will use Kimi and how you will evaluate it; estimated token usage and milestones are optional.
Submit by December 8 and wait for the review result by email.

name.zh: Qoder 开发者通行证 Ultra：开源贡献者 1 个月 Ultra 加 20,000 Credits
name.en: Qoder Developer Pass Ultra: 1 month of Ultra with 20,000 Credits for open-source contributors

summary.zh: Qoder 面向开源维护者和活跃贡献者的申请制权益，审核通过后直接发到个人 Qoder 账号。
summary.en: An application-based Qoder benefit for open-source maintainers and active contributors, granted straight to your personal Qoder account once approved.

benefit.zh: 新用户和当前没有付费订阅的个人用户：1 个月 Qoder Ultra（含 20,000 Credits，官方标价值 200 美元）。当前在付费订阅期内的个人用户：改发 20,000 Credits 叠加资源包，3 个月有效，原订阅不变。
benefit.en: New users and individuals with no current paid subscription get 1 month of Qoder Ultra (20,000 Credits included, listed at $200). Individuals within a paid subscription period get a 20,000-Credit add-on pack valid for 3 months instead, and their plan is unchanged.

eligibility.zh: 须同时满足：有个人 Qoder 账号且所在地区在服务范围内；GitHub 账号注册满 2 年且状态正常；近 90 天在 OSI 许可的公开仓库有提交、评审 PR、发版或维护 Issue 等记录。另需满足任一贡献标准：维护仓库合计 1,000 Stars 以上、被 100 个公开仓库或 30 个开源包依赖、包月下载量合计 5 万以上、近 12 个月向他人仓库合并 20 个 PR、近 12 个月有 10 位独立外部贡献者合并 PR，或是认可的开源基金会或主流语言项目的核心成员；没达标但在持续维护活跃项目（含 Agent Skills、MCP、插件、CLI）也可申请并说明。
eligibility.en: All of these apply: a personal Qoder account in a supported region; a GitHub account at least 2 years old in good standing; and public activity in the last 90 days (commits, PR reviews, releases or issue maintenance) in repos under an OSI-approved license. You also need one contribution criterion: 1,000+ total stars on repos you maintain, 100+ dependent public repos or 30+ dependent packages, 50,000+ monthly package downloads, 20+ merged PRs to others' repos in 12 months, PRs merged from 10+ independent outside contributors in 12 months, or core membership in a recognized open-source foundation or major language project. Below the thresholds but actively maintaining a project (including Agent Skills, MCP, plugins, CLI) you may still apply and explain.

zh: 需申请、审核通过才有：5 到 7 个工作日按提交顺序滚动审核，只通知通过的申请人；每位开发者限领一次，每个 GitHub 账号提交一次即可。
1 个月 Ultra 到期后自动回到免费版，不自动续费、不产生费用；叠加资源包到期后失效，原订阅仍按原方案计费。
Credits 只在各自有效期内可用，到期未用完清零、不结转；权益不含独立 API 调用额度，仅限本人使用，不可转让、不可折现。
团队版和企业版席位不适用，成员可用个人 Qoder 账号单独申请。
虚构贡献、操纵仓库数据、买卖或共享账号、转售服务等行为，官方可拒绝申请、取消资格、收回权益。
姓名和项目默认不公开展示，只有在申请表里主动勾选同意才会展示，勾不勾不影响审核。
en: Approval required: applications are reviewed in order of submission within 5 to 7 business days, and only approved applicants are notified. Each developer can claim once, and one submission per GitHub account is enough.
The 1-month Ultra returns to the free plan afterward with no auto-renewal and no charge; the add-on pack lapses at its end and your existing plan keeps billing as before.

Credits work only within their validity period; unused Credits are cleared at the end and do not carry over. The benefit has no separate API quota, is for you only, and cannot be transferred or cashed out.
Teams and Enterprise seats are excluded; members can apply with a personal Qoder account.
Faked contributions, manipulated repo data, buying or sharing accounts and reselling the service can lead to rejection, disqualification or reclaimed benefits.
Your name and projects are not shown publicly unless you tick consent in the form, and ticking it does not affect review.

cost.zh: 免费申请，不附带发帖或拉新要求。

name.en: SiliconFlow: Xing4.1-Preview API free for a limited time

summary.zh: 硅基流动国内站上架天翼 AI 的 Xing4.1-Preview（285B MoE，1M 上下文），模型页把输入、输出和缓存命中 tokens 都标为免费，页面标注「限时免费」。
summary.en: SiliconFlow's China site hosts China Telecom AI's Xing4.1-Preview (285B MoE, 1M context). The model page lists input, output and cache-hit tokens as free and labels it free for a limited time.

benefit.zh: 调用 XingChenAGI/Xing4.1-Preview 的输入、输出、缓存命中 tokens 单价都是 0 元；上下文 1,048,576 Tokens，支持深度思考、工具调用和 JSON 模式。
benefit.en: Input, output and cache-hit tokens for XingChenAGI/Xing4.1-Preview all cost ¥0. Context is 1,048,576 tokens, with deep thinking, tool calling and JSON mode supported.

eligibility.zh: 硅基流动国内站注册用户，自己创建 API Key。
eligibility.en: Registered SiliconFlow China users, who create their own API key.

zh: 「限时免费」是官方在模型页标注的活动，页面没写截止日期，随时可能改回收费。
不支持图片输入和前缀续写；最大输出长度官方页写「暂未提供」。
模型页没列限速；官方限速文档称免费模型限额固定，平台也在按模型分批改成动态限流，实际以模型广场显示为准。
官方页没写是否要求实名认证或账户余额。
硅基流动是自有推理平台，这里的免费是平台官方模型页标的价格，不是第三方中转；同平台 TokenPlus 上的同名免费版没有官方页佐证，不在本条范围。
en: “Free for a limited time” is the platform's own label on the model page, with no end date given, so it can return to paid at any time.
Image input and prefix completion are not supported; the page lists the maximum output length as not yet available.

The model page lists no rate limits. SiliconFlow's rate-limit docs say free models have fixed limits and that dynamic rate limiting is being rolled out model by model, so check the model page for the live values.
The official page does not say whether real-name verification or an account balance is required.

SiliconFlow runs its own inference platform, and the free price is the one shown on its official model page rather than a third-party relay; the same-named free listing on its TokenPlus product has no official page backing and is not covered by this entry.

deadline.zh: 官方未写截止日期，页面标注「限时免费」。
deadline.en: No end date given; the page labels it free for a limited time.

en: Sign up and sign in to SiliconFlow China.
Create an API key in the console.
Set the base URL to https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1, use the model XingChenAGI/Xing4.1-Preview and call it in the OpenAI-compatible format.

summary.en: From November 26 to December 2, QwenWork personal and enterprise standard users pick MiniMax M3.1 Flash for chat, creation and office tasks with no credits used for text inference.

benefit.en: During the promotion, picking MiniMax M3.1 Flash (marked “限免”) for chat, creation and office tasks uses no credits for large-language-model text inference.

eligibility.zh: 千问办公个人版（套餐页含 0 元免费版）和企业标准版用户，无需报名、无需额外开通；国际版和企业旗舰版不适用。
eligibility.en: QwenWork personal users (the plans page includes a ¥0 free plan) and enterprise standard users, with no sign-up or extra activation; the international version and enterprise ultimate edition are excluded.

zh: 活动时间 2026 年 11 月 26 日 11:00 至 12 月 2 日 23:59（北京时间），只有 MiniMax M3.1 Flash 免费，其他模型照常扣积分。
只覆盖官方渠道（网页版、桌面端、钉钉 PC 端入口）里的大语言模型文本推理费用；多模态理解与生成（图像、文档、音视频、生图）、请求总结、网页内容总结、联网搜索等附加项不在内，积分仍可能被扣。
模型有每分钟请求量上限，高峰期可能变慢或排队；账户欠费时限免模型也无法调用。
用反向代理、爬虫、脚本、多账号合并套用额度或绕过限速属违规，官方会限流、暂停或封号并追回所得。
活动结束后恢复正常计费，已有会话和创作内容不受影响。
en: The promotion runs from November 26, 2026 at 11:00 to December 2 at 23:59 (Beijing time). Only MiniMax M3.1 Flash is free; other models still use credits.

Only large-language-model text inference through official channels (web app, desktop app and the DingTalk PC entry) is covered. Multimodal understanding and generation (images, documents, audio and video, image generation), request or web-page summaries and web search are not, and credits may still be deducted for them.
The model has a per-minute request cap, so peak hours may be slow or queued; an account in arrears cannot call even the free model.
Reverse proxies, crawlers, scripts, multiple accounts pooling the quota or bypassing limits count as violations; QwenWork can throttle, suspend or ban accounts and reclaim the benefit.
Normal billing resumes afterward; existing sessions and content are unaffected.

cost.en: Free during the promotion, within the stated scope.

deadline.en: Ends December 2, 2026 at 23:59 (Beijing time).

Chat, create or work as usual, and check credit usage in Session history or billing records.
